intro: Darion Mograine is the younger son of the fallen Highlord Alexandros Mograine, the legendary Ashbringer. A paladin who joined the Argent Dawn following his father's mysterious downfall, Darion's desperate quest to uncover his family's fate placed him at the center of the conflict consuming the Plaguelands.

sections.t: A Son of the Silver Hand
p: Darion grew up in the shadow of his father's towering legacy. Raised near Brill in the kingdom of Lordaeron, he witnessed the onset of the plague of undeath and joined the Knights of the Silver Hand shortly after the Third War. After falling in battle at Stratholme and narrowly surviving, Darion's world unraveled when his father perished under suspicious circumstances. Struggling with grief and questioning his faith in the Holy Light, Darion chose a different road than the zealous Scarlet Crusade, ultimately throwing his lot in with the newly formed Argent Dawn.
